title: Room for all your agents.
description: One studio for coding agents across projects, backends, and machines. Start with a conversation. Grow into a workspace for everything you’re building.

title: Your first agent
description: Go from a fresh installation to a useful conversation. You don’t need a project or a remote server to begin.

title: Bring your projects
description: Give your agents a place to work, and give yourself the code context to follow along. A project can bring several repository roots together.

title: Review the work
description: Read the code, understand the change, and leave feedback exactly where it belongs. Keep the conversation connected to the work.

title: Keep many agents in view
description: Move between projects without losing track of who is working, who needs you, and what is ready to review.

title: Pick up where you left off
description: Find earlier conversations and resume their context. Understand the difference between an active agent and its saved session.

title: Your laptop. Your servers.
description: Run agents where your projects live. Connect to a home server and a work server, leave work running, and reconnect when you’re ready.

title: Let agents work together
description: Use Tyde subagents to delegate across CLI backends. Give each agent a clear role and follow the work in the same studio.

title: Make expertise reusable
description: Define your specialists once. Give them instructions, skills, and tools that can be used across supported backends on a host.

title: Give parallel work its space
description: Use workbenches to keep independent changes on separate branches and working trees, while keeping them connected to their parent project.

title: A day in your studio
description: Three complete ways to work: several projects on remote servers, implementation with a second reviewer, and a reusable project specialist.

title: Configure your studio
description: Know which machine a setting changes, how backend options relate to Tyde, and where to configure code intelligence and integrations.

title: Find your way back
description: Practical recovery steps for unavailable backends, disconnected hosts, missing sessions, and code navigation that needs attention.
